description: Return the global risk-on/risk-off sentiment series used for FX regime analysis. The result includes a derived composite score, regime label, component contributions, pagination, and data_quality metadata. Suited to cross-asset regime context for high-beta, safe-haven, commodity, or USD-defensive FX conditions. Access: free, no API key required.

after_sequence.description: changes only: return changes after this sequence.

end_date.description: Optional inclusive end date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

start_date.description: Optional inclusive start date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

view.description: series (default): the score history. changes: a resumable feed of recorded additions and revisions; pass pagination.next_after_sequence back as after_sequence.

name: risk_sentiment
title: Global Risk Sentiment
